claims.1: For every B.1-B.7 process, sup_n ||z_n|| is finite almost surely.
claims.2: For every B.1-B.7 process, tracking and joint error converge to zero almost surely.
claims.3: For every Appendix B process, one sample-path finite K bounds all n.
claims.4: Under Appendix F and inherited Appendix B premises, exact unprojected TDC(lambda) converges almost surely under off-policy Markov sampling.

falsification_rule: FALSIFIED only if a counterexample satisfies every premise and mathematically contradicts the exact quantified statement. Finite growth, overflow, failed convergence, or an assumption violation is not falsification.
search: Twelve nonnormal Markov SA cells across shear, mixing, and seed; two longer holdouts selected by a preregistered worst-tail rule; four high-importance-ratio positive-lambda TDC cells.
